description: While disabled, a POST /mcp with a chunked body is answered 503 {"error":"service disabled"} without reading the body for the app: availability is checked before the body (MCPWARP.md §4.4, D-2026-10-14-03). After the 503 the agent drains the unread body and CLOSEs; it never RESETs (§4.4 Ending a refused stream, D-2026-10-14-06).
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

14
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id
14
":1,"method":"ping"}
0
out:
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 28

{"error":"service disabled"}
notes: Reach sdkState disabled with a matching disable op on the live connection (MCPWARP.md §10.3). The SDK MAY write the 503 before the edge has finished writing the body; the stream still ends with CLOSE once the body is drained.
